nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_lookup
nodes.summary: Every actual slice lookup is the identical canonical signed value at its explicitly computed source index.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_restrict
nodes.summary: Restrict only the strict slice window, retaining the same actual output streams and source packing.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_empty
nodes.summary: A zero-length affine slice still requires real packed source and output tables; its strict entry window is empty.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_extensional_unique
nodes.summary: Two slices of the same window agree in their represented signed entries, not necessarily their codes or component streams.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_extend
nodes.summary: A preserved actual prefix and one real source lookup extend the slice without changing any earlier represented value.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary induction constructs the affine output by actual two-beta extension, including zero length and zero stride.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_exists_extensionally_unique
nodes.summary: Construct an affine slice and prove extensional uniqueness, with no supplied slice, function, or finite-choice oracle.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_exists
nodes.summary: Construct an actual affine slice and actual positive/negative prefix-sum traces; the result is not a supplied sum oracle.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_functional
nodes.summary: The canonical signed affine-sum value is independent of every permissible slice encoding.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_empty_value
nodes.summary: Every actual empty affine sum is the canonical signed zero, irrespective of offset or stride.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_empty_exists
nodes.summary: A valid source actually admits an empty slice and its zero sum, rather than merely a vacuous uniqueness assertion.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_successor_decompose
nodes.summary: A successor affine sum decomposes into its actual prefix sum and actual last source entry with the original SignedAdd relation.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_successor_intro
nodes.summary: Extend both beta streams by the actual next source value and append the actual signed sum; no output slice is assumed.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_successor_add
nodes.summary: Any two actual consecutive affine sums and their true intervening source value satisfy the signed addition law.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_slice_sum_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Every finite affine window of a genuine source table has a constructed and literally unique canonical signed sum.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_lookup
nodes.summary: Each actual row-table entry is the actual signed sum of the corresponding affine source slice.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_restrict_outer
nodes.summary: Removing the last row preserves every actual earlier row sum and the same output encoding.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_empty
nodes.summary: Zero rows impose no fictitious row values but still certify genuine source and row-table packings.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_extensional_unique
nodes.summary: All genuine row-sum tables agree entrywise in canonical signed values, without identifying arbitrary beta encodings.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_extend
nodes.summary: A preserved row-table prefix extends by one actually proved slice sum, never by an assumed finite-choice table.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary induction computes each finite slice sum and appends its actual signed value to construct the entire row-sum table.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_exists_extensionally_unique
nodes.summary: Construct a genuine row-sum table and prove its precise extensional uniqueness at every i<m.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_sum_exists
nodes.summary: Construct the whole row-sum table and then its actual finite sum; both finite dimensions are arbitrary.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_sum_functional
nodes.summary: All actual representations of the same rectangular sum have the identical canonical signed result.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_sum_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Every genuine source and every finite affine rectangle admit a constructed, unique signed double-sum value.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_sum_zero_outer
nodes.summary: A rectangle with zero rows has actual signed total zero, including when its column count is nonzero.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_sums_zero_inner
nodes.summary: Induction proves the sum of any actual table of empty row sums is zero; a positive number of zero-length rows is not silently discarded.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_sum_zero_inner
nodes.summary: A rectangle with zero columns has actual signed total zero for every row count.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_columns_successor_add
nodes.summary: Appending one real grid row adds its actual entries pointwise to the actual column-sum table, using only the elementary equality of the two coordinate expressions.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_fubini
nodes.summary: Ordinary row-count induction proves finite signed Fubini for arbitrary affine grids, including both zero dimensions, by constructing the missing prefix column table and applying actual signed sum linearity.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_fubini_exists
nodes.summary: Construct actual row and column sum tables and actual signed sum traces sharing one canonical value; no supplied slice, table, sum, or permutation witness is required.

nodes.name: signed_rectangular_row_major_fubini
nodes.summary: Every actual row-major m-by-n signed beta table has constructed row and column sums with exactly the same total, including zero rows or columns.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorFourCode
nodes.summary: One canonical injective doubled-Cantor code for all four signed-minor beta-code parameters.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance
nodes.summary: The original canonical code z represents the integer difference p−n; these supplied components need not be normalized.

nodes.name: ArithAt
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta entries of the packed table represent the unique canonical signed value z. Distinct component representations need not be equal.

nodes.name: ArithTableEqual
nodes.summary: Pointwise equality of actual canonical signed lookups below l, not equality of table codes or their positive/negative components.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: ArithTable
nodes.summary: An actual packed signed table with canonical signed entries through index N, including index zero. It contains no divisor transform or inversion hypothesis.

nodes.name: SignedAdd
nodes.summary: Actual addition of original canonical signed codes, witnessed by their decoders and balanced equality.

nodes.name: ArithAdd
nodes.summary: Three actual signed tables and witnessed SignedAdd entries at each i<l. The unused endpoint certified by ArithTable(l,...) is not included in the prefix sum.

nodes.name: ArithExtend
nodes.summary: A genuine output signed table through l preserves the represented source values at i<l and records the prescribed signed value z at l. Existence is proved by recoding both beta streams.

nodes.name: ArithSlice
nodes.summary: Actual signed tables with witnessed values G(i)=F(o+s*i) for i<l. The output is constructed by real beta-stream recoding; its separately certified endpoint is unused.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedPrefixSum
nodes.summary: The signed balance of two actual natural finite sums, at exactly the indices 0<=i<l. Existence, uniqueness and representation independence are proved separately.

nodes.name: SignedSliceSum
nodes.summary: An actually constructed affine slice followed by its genuine signed prefix sum. Both zero length and zero stride are meaningful; no sum oracle is part of the graph.

nodes.name: ArithRowSums
nodes.summary: An actual row table R contains, at i<m, the signed sum of the n entries F((o+s*i)+t*j). Source and row-table packings are explicit, including empty dimensions.

nodes.name: SignedRectangularSum
nodes.summary: Construct an actual row-sum table and take its actual m-entry signed sum. Equality after swapping strides and dimensions is the independently proved finite Fubini theorem.
